A '''hyperdrive converter''' was a component of a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. At one point, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|boy]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] bartered with a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]], eventually acquiring a damaged hyperdrive converter among other items.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />
